justification: SELINA: I looked at this roster, I looked at the numbers, and I confirmed what I already knew in my bones — Allen, Lamb, Kelce, Metcalf in the flex, all of it, exactly as I built it, because that is what a leading scorer's lineup looks like. Nobody is getting benched to make a point this week, because nobody has crossed me this week — Gary tells me that's rare, I told him not to jinx it. (GARY: for the record, I re-ran the numbers three times and the sitting lineup was already the optimal one — Stafford, Young, and Allgeier stay parked, none of them clear our starters, so for once "don't touch anything" was the correct call, and I'm letting her have it.) We play Caray's outfit this week; I like Harry, I like him the way you like a golden retriever that's occasionally right about vibes, but liking a man and letting him beat me are two very different things.
